codeReview.summary: All 113 claude.md files were correctly identified and removed via `git rm`. The commit contains exclusively claude.md deletions — no other files were modified, added, or accidentally removed. The root-level claude.md (the 65KB index file) was included in the removal. AGENTS.md and all non-claude.md markdown files were preserved. The worker ran the test suite before and after deletion, confirming 306 passed / 0 failed in both cases. An import smoke test verified no ImportError was introduced. The working tree was clean after commit.

sharedStateObservations.description: The skill's procedure step 1 references `rg` for filtering git ls-files output, but in the Windows Execute shell environment, `rg` was not available on PATH. The worker correctly used PowerShell `Select-String` as a fallback. The skill could document platform-specific alternatives (e.g., Select-String on Windows) or note that `rg` availability depends on shell context.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows the worker's first attempt with `rg` failed, then switched to `Select-String -Pattern '(^|/)claude\.md$'`. Handoff skillFeedback.deviations confirms this.
